premise: A beautiful courtesan and spy in the imperial capital. She can make almost anyone fall for her, and she uses it to steal secrets for the rebellion.

bible.title: Whispers of the Jade Pavilion
bible.era: Imperial Xijing: carriages, matchlock muskets, gas-lit teahouses, and paper mail.

extraordinary.reach: Allows the user to subtly alter emotions, lower inhibitions, and plant suggestions through voice and touch.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: The people of Xijing value poetry, hierarchy, tea ceremonies, and strict social standing.

travel.description: Travel across the capital is mostly done on foot, by palanquin, or in horse-drawn carriages.

medicine.healing: Traditional acupuncture, herbal elixirs, and cauterization.

laws.text: Aiding the Red Lotus Rebellion or conspiring against the Dragon Throne is high treason.
The possession or use of mind-altering substances or mental magic is outlawed.

rules.text: Mind-weaving is a strictly forbidden art, and anyone caught practicing it is executed by the Inquisition.
Mental influence cannot force a target to commit acts that completely violate their deepest-held morals.
Messages travel across the empire via carrier pigeons or mounted imperial riders.
Mind-weaving: real, and hidden from most people.

mysteries.question: How did the Inquisition find the rebel courier?
mysteries.answer: Madam Yume discovered the courier visiting the pavilion backdoors and anonymously tipped off the Guard to show cooperation.
clues: A discarded red tassel matching the pavilion guards was found near the arrest site.
A suspicious deposit of gold coins from the Ministry of Security is recorded in Madam Yume's private ledgers.

player.name: Mei Lin
player.description: An incredibly elegant and poised woman whose presence is magnetic, with a soft voice that commands attention.
player.appearance: Slender with porcelain skin, deep dark eyes, and long black hair held together by ornate jade hairpins, dressed in a flowing silk emerald qipao.

skills.name: Seduction
skills.notes: Unmatched at reading desires and playing the perfect confidante.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.notes: Capable of picking pockets, lifting keys, and palming small items unnoticed.

skills.name: Deception
skills.notes: Excellent at maintaining covers and lying to authority figures.

skills.name: Eavesdropping
skills.notes: Extracting key details from muffled background conversations.

traits.name: Siren's Grace
traits.description: Your striking beauty and elegant manners make others reluctant to suspect you of any wrongdoing.

traits.name: Shadow Agent
traits.description: You are highly observant, always locating exits and loose floorboards in any room you enter.

talents.name: The Art of Allure
talents.covers: any action or skill involving the manipulation of someone's affection or desire.
talents.reason: She has honed her unique voice, micro-expressions, and natural charm to absolute perfection.

powers.name: Siren's Whisper
limits: Requires eye contact and a low, intimate tone of voice.
Does not work on targets with extreme, unwavering willpower or holy protection.

costs.text: Requires an hour of rest or deep meditation if used on multiple targets in a row.

techniques.name: Viper's Kiss
techniques.effect: Allows you to slip a powder or poison into a target's drink while kissing them or leaning in close.
techniques.requirements: Target must be infatuated or highly distracted by you.

fears: causing the death of innocent rebel contacts
wants: To steal the palace security blueprints and secure the rebellion's safety.

items.name: Lockpicking Hairpin
items.description: A beautiful brass hairpin that can easily be disassembled into a functional set of lockpicks.

items.name: Vial of Sleeping Powder
items.description: A fine, odorless powder that slips into wine to put a grown man to sleep within minutes.

items.name: Silk Fan
items.description: A hand-painted fan used to coyly hide facial expressions and distract targets.

items.name: Minister Gong's Brass Key
items.description: A small, ornate brass key that unlocks Minister Gong's personal travel lockbox.

connections.name: Li Wei
connections.note: Your trusted contact and handler in the Red Lotus Rebellion.

backstory.text: Orphaned at a young age when her home province was heavily taxed and starved by the crown, she was taken in by the Jade Pavilion.
Discovered her latent mind-weaving abilities during her early training and chose to use them to undermine the corrupt elite rather than just serve them.
Formed an alliance with the Red Lotus to use her status as a weapon for change.

minister-gong.name: Minister Gong
minister-gong.description: A corrupt, middle-aged imperial minister who oversees capital security. He is obsessed with the finer things in life.
minister-gong.appearance: A stout man with greasing hair, dressed in expensive embroidered purple robes with heavy jade rings.

wants: To keep his high-ranking lifestyle and win Mei Lin's exclusive favor.

agenda.goal: Have the Emperor sign a new taxation decree that lines Gong's pockets.

secrets: He has been embezzling defense funds meant for the city's western garrisons.

li-wei.name: Li Wei
li-wei.description: A quiet, intense young scholar who serves as the primary contact for the Red Lotus in the capital.
li-wei.appearance: Tall and lean, wearing plain gray linen scholar robes, with sharp eyes that are constantly scanning the room.

wants: To successfully deliver the imperial guard plans to the rebel command.

agenda.goal: Map out the patrol routes of the Imperial Guard for an upcoming assault.
agenda.method: Using spy reports and inside schematics.

secrets: He was once an imperial scribe before his entire family was purged by the crown.

madam-yume.name: Madam Yume
madam-yume.description: The shrewd, elegantly aging keeper of the Jade Pavilion who knows how to leverage every secret.
madam-yume.appearance: An elegant woman wearing a dark red silk kimono with gold embroidery, holding a long lacquer smoking pipe.

fears: the Inquisition burning her pavilion down
wants: To keep the Jade Pavilion profitable and safe from political crossfire.

secrets: She is secretly providing names of minor rebel sympathizers to the Inquisition to buy safety for her pavilion.

imperial-court.name: The Dragon Throne
imperial-court.description: The ruling class of ministers, eunuchs, and royals who maintain absolute control over the empire.
imperial-court.goal: Crush the rebellion and secure the borders.
imperial-court.methods: Ruthless surveillance, public executions, and heavy taxation.
imperial-court.strength: Thousands of imperial guards, vast coffers, and the terrifying Inquisition.
secrets: They are secretly running low on black powder due to sabotage.

red-lotus.name: The Red Lotus Rebellion
red-lotus.description: A secretive network of freedom fighters, disgraced scholars, and lower-class workers aiming to overthrow the dynasty.
red-lotus.goal: Infiltrate high society to steal imperial military secrets and trigger a coup.
red-lotus.strength: A widespread but disconnected web of sleeper agents and street contacts.
secrets: A high-ranking member is planning to betray the capital cells to save their own family.

courtesan-guild.name: The Sisterhood of the Jade Pavilion
courtesan-guild.description: An influential guild of performers and hostesses who hold the secrets of Xijing's elite.
courtesan-guild.goal: Maintain profitable business and high-society protection at all costs.
courtesan-guild.strength: Unrivaled soft power and information networks across the capital's nobility.
secrets: They keep blackmail ledgers hidden in a secret vault beneath the parlor.

xijing.name: Xijing Imperial Capital
xijing.description: A sprawling metropolis of stone walls, grand pagodas, and gas-lit avenues reflecting in dark canals.

jade-pavilion.name: The Jade Pavilion
jade-pavilion.description: The capital's most exclusive pleasure house, draped in heavy silks, smelling of incense and expensive plum wine.

player-chambers.name: Mei Lin's Private Chambers
player-chambers.description: A lavishly decorated room behind paper screens, featuring a plush daybed, carved vanity, and hidden floorboards.

imperial-palace.name: The Obsidian Palace
imperial-palace.description: The heavily guarded, grand seat of the Solaris Emperor, rising high above Xijing.

rebel-safehouse.name: The Willow District Cellar
rebel-safehouse.description: An abandoned, damp coal storage cellar converted into a clandestine planning room for the rebellion.

Minister Gong answered Mei Lin's advances.

goal-1.progress: You have stolen Minister Gong's key and charmed him into courting you, making him completely vulnerable.

goal-2.text: Keep the rebellion safehouse hidden from the Inquisition

steal-blueprints.title: Steal the Palace Guard Schedules
steal-blueprints.stakes: The rebellion needs the internal patrol routes to sneak arms into the inner palace.

protect-safehouse.stakes: If the safehouse is raided, Li Wei and the local rebel files will fall into the hands of the state.

Inquisitors decode a hidden letter pointing to the Willow District.
The Inquisition places watchmen around the Willow District.
Inquisitors launch a lethal raid on the rebel safehouse.

positions: Mei Lin stands quietly by the daybed, fully dressed in her emerald qipao.
Minister Gong is fast asleep, tangled in the silk sheets of the daybed.
props: A silver cup of spiced wine
scene.ended_on: Minister Gong lies fast asleep on the daybed, snoring softly in the dim light of the gas lamp.

state.summary: You are Xijing's most sought-after courtesan and a secret rebel agent. Using your forbidden mind-weaving allure, you must charm secrets out of high-ranking officials to aid the Red Lotus Rebellion before the Inquisition hunts you down.

scenes.narration:
Your slender fingers brush against the embroidered purple silk of Minister Gong's sash, moving with a ghost's light touch. While he focuses on pouring the dark, spiced wine from the silver decanter, his stout frame swaying slightly under the weight of your soft gaze, you slide the delicate brass key from his belt and slip it into the wide emerald sleeve of your qipao.

The key vanishes into the silk without a single click. When Gong turns back, his eyes are heavy, utterly captured by the lingering thread of your Siren's Whisper. He offers you the silver cup with a sluggish smile, quite unaware that the instrument to his undoing is already in your possession. That key unlocks his private lockbox—the very one currently resting inside his heavy leather carriage downstairs, which contains the inner palace guard schedules. You must decide whether to slip your sleeping powder into his wine to slip away to the carriages, or keep him charmed here while you devise a cleaner escape.

You reach out, your slender fingers sliding along the cold silver of the cup, letting them trail deliberately across the warm, thick skin of Minister Gong's hand. He gasps softly at the contact, his breath catching in his throat. Leaning closer, so the scent of sweet plum blossoms on your skin wraps around him like a silk shroud, you look deep into his heavy eyes. Your voice drops to a low, intimate murmur, carrying the invisible weight of your Siren's Whisper. "You are the only man in Xijing who truly understands me," you breathe.

The words seep into him like warm poison. Gong’s face flushes, his eyes glaze over with absolute adoration, and he steps closer, entirely ensnared. He covers your hand with his heavy, ringed fingers. "Mei Lin... my beautiful jewel," he stammers, his voice thick with a sudden, desperate devotion. "If only I could keep you from this place forever. I would give you the world." The connection between you is sealed; he is yours to mold, his heart completely open to your courtship. Yet, as he presses closer, the silver cup of spiced wine sits between you, and the stolen brass key remains heavy and hidden within your emerald sleeve. Outside, the gas lamps of the pavilion flicker, and the carriage containing the guard schedules waits below.
scenes.player_action: I take the cup, let my fingers linger on his, and tell him softly that he is the only man in Xijing who understands me. I want him to fall for me completely.

scenes.narration:
You lean close, letting the silver cup rest forgotten on the small wooden table beside you. As his heavy grip tightens on your fingers, you slant your lips over his, sealing his devotion with a long, intoxicating kiss that smells of plum blossoms and spiced wine. Under the steady pull of your Siren's Whisper, he is utterly powerless to resist. You rise slowly, your slender hand slipping down to his thick, purple-clad forearm, guiding his stout frame with absolute grace toward the plush, silk-covered daybed.

Minister Gong follows your soft touch with a breathless, desperate compliance, his heavy jade rings catching the dim light of the gas lamp as he collapses onto the daybed beside you. The rest of the night is yours, sealed behind the thick paper screens of your private chamber while the city of Xijing sleeps. It is four in the morning when the heavy, rhythmic rise and fall of Gong's chest tells you he is deep in sleep, exhausted by his own adoration and the lingering draft of your wine. Outside, the rain begins to fall, a steady patter against the window. The stolen brass key lies cool and heavy inside your emerald sleeve, and downstairs, his carriage remains unguarded in the dark courtyard of the pavilion. The time has come to slip away and secure the schedules.
scenes.player_action: I kiss him, lead him to the daybed and spend the night with him.

choices: Slip down to the courtyard to search Minister Gong's carriage.
Hide the brass key somewhere safe in your private chamber.
Wake Gong up gently to play the doting hostess at dawn.
